rationale: Test-only: adds a codegen test pinning that ui.js binds a meter by its value key (with or without a routed source), and re-points the emitter-conformance allowlist's kelvin meter-binding entry from #10983 to #11010 with a reason naming the native and baked C++ binders as the lanes with the gap. No emitter, importer, Chromium, rendering or packaging code changes, so no design-import authority moves.
